Top five stories a competent UK editor would lead with today, and whether the research confirms them:

   CONFIRMED — BBC (22 Sep 01:31 UTC; 21 Sep 21:00 UTC), Guardian (21 Sep 21:33 UTC), AP via ABC (21 Sep), BBC G7 (22 Sep 04:21 UTC).

3. Oil rebounds above $100 after a four-session slide; Brent $100.65 (Reuters 05:57 UTC) / above $101 (Bloomberg); gilts 5.25%; US diesel record $6.50; IEA inventories -507mb since February.

4. Trump-Zelensky meeting today: energy-ceasefire push, "diesel, diesel, diesel"; Russia overnight strikes kill three in Dnipro; ISW on Duma results (355/450) and Alabuga drone expansion.
   CONFIRMED — Guardian (21 Sep 16:54 UTC), Irish Times/Reuters (22 Sep), ISW (22 Sep 00:34 UTC), ABC (Zelensky post).

5. Ed Davey's closing conference speech today: 10p fuel-duty cut, £1 bus cap, 10% rail cut, "candidate to be prime minister", global pause on superintelligent AI / International AI Safety Agency; criticism of Burnham's US AI partnership.
   CONFIRMED — BBC (20 Sep, 21 Sep, 22 Sep), AP via ABC (Davey quote on Trump).
